description: Skills and XP per labour (F3, ADR 062). Every worker labour has a skill level 0..N, N = the length of xp_to_next.

xp_to_next.description: xp_to_next[L] is the XP a colonist at level L earns to reach level L + 1 (XP restarts at 0 on each level); its length is the top level.

speed_percent_at_min.description: Work speed at level 0, in percent of a job's work_ticks rate.

speed_percent_at_max.description: Work speed at the top level; levels in between are linear (integer division).

carry_labour.description: The labour whose level raises hands capacity.

carry_bonus_every.description: One extra unit in the hands per this many levels of carry_labour.

default.description: XP for a completed job of a kind not listed in by_kind.

by_kind.description: Job kind -> XP for one completed job of that kind (an integer >= 0).

starting.description: Seeded starting levels: major_count distinct labours at major_min..major_max, the rest at minor_min..minor_max (inclusive), drawn from the world seed.
